components.text: Introducing the 'Core' feed! You can now filter app content to highlight articles written by our editors. Select the 'Core' view from the drop-down menu or set it is as default in the Settings. Other changes: - Change Dark Background to true black (helpful for OLED screens) - Removes Play Services App Invites functionality - Update SDK to Nougat - Open Source Attribution - Video list fixed to handle click properly
